summary.clientName: Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of West Bengal
summary.executiveSummary: This tender represents a high-value pharmaceutical procurement opportunity with strong strategic alignment for healthcare and hospital supply operations. The contract duration is two years with optional extension. The bidder must demonstrate regulatory compliance, manufacturing capacity and proven market standing.
summary.recommendation: Proceed with bid preparation. Focus review efforts on penalty clauses, supply obligations, quality assurance requirements and performance guarantee commitments.

highlights.title: High Value Procurement Opportunity
highlights.description: Multi-year pharmaceutical procurement contract estimated at INR 140 million.

highlights.title: Valid GMP Certification Required
highlights.description: All manufacturing facilities must possess valid GMP certification throughout the tender period.

highlights.title: Non Conviction Certificate
highlights.description: Bidder must submit valid NCC from the relevant regulatory authority.
highlights.recommendedAction: Ensure latest NCC documentation is attached.

highlights.title: Minimum Turnover Requirement
highlights.description: Bidders supplying up to two items must demonstrate average annual turnover of INR 10 Crores.
highlights.recommendedAction: Validate turnover eligibility before bid submission.

highlights.title: Performance Bank Guarantee
highlights.description: Successful bidders must provide Performance Bank Guarantee equal to 5% of contract value subject to tender conditions.
highlights.recommendedAction: Review financial exposure and guarantee arrangements.

highlights.title: Delayed Delivery Penalty
highlights.description: Financial penalties apply for delayed deliveries beyond contractual timelines.
highlights.recommendedAction: Assess supply chain readiness and buffer stock planning.

highlights.title: Blacklisting Risk
highlights.description: Repeated supply failures may result in blacklisting and forfeiture of performance guarantees.
highlights.recommendedAction: Escalate for executive review before bid approval.

highlights.title: Mandatory Supporting Documentation
highlights.description: Tender requires licenses, certificates, turnover statements, tax filings and technical submissions.
